integrity: The exact formula, subalgebra count, nonpermuting-pair count, and parity limit are proved symbolically. Independent brute-force enumeration is supplied as finite regression evidence and is not used as an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns central abelian stabilizations of the three-dimensional Heisenberg Lie algebra and does not classify arbitrary two-step nilpotent Lie algebras.
The finite checker covers small prime-field cases only; arbitrary prime powers and arbitrary central dimension are justified by the symbolic proof.
The zero- and one-dimensional central cases are prior special cases; the new claim is the uniform formula for arbitrary central dimension and its parity asymptotic.
A residual literature risk remains that an older subgroup-commutativity calculation for the Lazard-corresponding direct-product p-group may imply a prime-field specialization.
title: Central stabilization of the Heisenberg algebra has a parity law for subalgebra commutativity
